description: This file is a library of functions designed to process and mark up test script output for GitHub workflows, allowing for pretty-printing and status annotations directly in GitHub. It includes functions to handle test start, finalize test cases, and output formatting with error or notice indicators.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes output markup, verifies environment variables, and prepares output file for test logs.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes test cases by appending status messages or errors to the markup output, and manages grouping in GitHub annotations.
